title: Carina: portrait round 3 (twelve options, hot Swedish blonde)
question: Is any of these the hot Swedish blonde Carina, or which parts (hair, face, glasses, clothes) should I combine?

media.caption: The twelve finals with the two extra seeds of 1 and 12, numbered, with the check result. Jørgen on round 2: "most of these come across as grey mouse, bit tame although I personally like them they are not really the hot swedish blonde type yet". This round: bright golden hair, defined faces, light makeup, a confident smile, styled hair, fitted practical office clothes; the face shapes, eyes and brows vary, though the model keeps a family resemblance (eyelashes, lips).
Attempt 1 of all twelve: golden reads golden, but chests too prominent, framing cut the hair, some canary yellow
Attempt 2 of all twelve: overcorrected, hair went dull dirty blonde, heads small, ring artifacts
Attempt 3 of all twelve: the golden is right; options 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 10, 12 were then re-framed for headroom (v4, v5 in each option)
